theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (η : Rn n → ℝ) (c : Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V U → ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => η x ^ 2 • (V x - c)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => η x ^ 2 • (V x - c)) ∧ tsupport (fun x => η x ^ 2 • (V x - c)) ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => η x ^ 2 • (V x - c)) x = η x ^ 2 • fderiv ℝ V x + (2 * η x) • (fderiv ℝ η x).smulRight (V x - c)
